notes.title: Major Update + Boomstock 2025! 🔥💀 September 23
notes.notes:
Major Update + Boomstock 2025! 🔥💀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

The wait is over, this is our largest update so far, packed with new content, a brutal new difficulty, performance improvements, and more. And we’re launching it alongside Boomstock 2025 on Steam!

To celebrate, HELLBREAK is 30% off throughout the event. If you’ve been waiting to dive in or bring a friend, now’s the perfect time.

Before we jump into the details:
💀 Thank you to everyone who’s supported us so far! We’re closing in on 100 reviews with 85% positive. If you’ve been enjoying the game, leaving a positive review really helps us grow and keep making HELLBREAK even better.

🏰 New Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

New Arena – Gravehold
"The shattered ruins of a forsaken stronghold, where corruption spreads upward from the depths below."
Our largest arena to date! Gravehold dynamically expands as you fight against demon waves, opening new rooms and areas as the slaughter continues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/fca4fc198e73043913716d1a4cd2c71c2cbf8781.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/29c15e68b0bf30d11e945952a65a9fae8278d857.png

New Weapon – Heretic’s Maw
A demonic skull of a heretic will aid you in battle, firing unholy fireballs against the horde. Its upgrades let you gain stacks to increase its power, turning it into an incredibly potent tool for clearing out hordes, especially when combined with the Inferno curse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/6e32c4c2c9d45f9e40a2605dc4458e88b6e80e1a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/5fc0e90b70cc05bf92208c6b60525954782b660d.png

New Spell – Onslaught
"Charge forward with unstoppable momentum, ramming through enemies to damage and hurl them aside. The charge also deflects any projectiles in your path, sending them crashing back toward their sources."
Mow down the horde with unstoppable force.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/edca810227920b360a669fe002c4a5e0e39e36b9.png

4th Difficulty – Abyss
Our hardest challenge yet. Abyss is now available for all arenas, complete with its own new difficulty modifiers and a 50% increased score bonus. Make sure your weapons and perks are upgraded, there will be no mercy. With the new difficulty and new map combined, you can earn 25 more Hellshards if you can beat them!

⚙️ Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png


 Bloodfang base damage per pellet: 66 → 70
 Viper base damage: 140 → 147
 Shredder base damage: 330→295
 Shredder reflect upgrade, damage bonus after reflecting off surfaces: 25% → 10%
 Shredder penetration upgrade, number of enemies penetrated: +3->+1
 Cinderheart cooldown per kill upgrade, cooldown per kill: 2s → 1s


🛠 Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Fixed an important issue that was causing some waves to spawn duplicated enemies (introduced last patch), making the game much harder at certain times.
 Fixed an issue causing bosses and some enemies to spawn incorrectly at rare instances.
 Fixed multiple issues related to specific spell-related blessings that were triggering for or with unintended spells.
 Fixed an issue with the damage reduction perk where it was not working as intended (reducing much less damage than what was displayed).
 Fixed multiple UI-related issues.
 Fixed an issue that was causing some blessings to reduce the total ammo count of weapons with no magazines (Maelstrom, Splinter, etc.). There may still be blessings/upgrades that have this issue, so please let us know if you run into it again.
 Fixed an issue that was causing the game to end even when a boss was still alive.
 Fixed an issue where assigning side mouse keys to inputs would display a missing key icon.


⚡ Performance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Implemented changes to reduce stutters that happen randomly throughout a trial.
 Implemented AI-related optimizations.
 We’re working on pre-shader compilation to eliminate the majority of stutters entirely. This is currently in testing, and we’re also trying to make it optional since enabling it increases RAM usage.


📝 What’s Next
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
We’re not slowing down, next patches will continue introducing quality-of-life improvements, community-suggested features, and more performance updates and options.

We’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and support so far, keep sharing your thoughts and bug reports on Steam Discussions and Discord to help us shape HELLBREAK’s future.

💀 Enjoy the update, and if you’ve been having a blast, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam, it truly helps us out!

notes.title: Content Update - Tutorial, New Weapon, Spell and Blessings - August 22
notes.notes:
⚔️ Content Update – Tutorial, Splinter & Bloodspire! ⚔️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
We’re back with a brand-new content update packed with fresh features for both new and veteran players!

🧭 Tutorial
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
HELLBREAK now has a tutorial to introduce the core mechanics and features to new players. Even if you’re already familiar with the game, we recommend giving it a run—you might discover details you’ve missed before.

🔪 New Weapon – Splinter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

A deadly throwing dagger made of bone has joined the armory! Splinter shines against groups of enemies, especially when upgraded. Better yet, it’s unlocked by default, so you can jump right in and try it out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/e7e78bd5486b21e73290edcc2fcf29b3cbe2b265.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/5ddeaf3418c7060db479e788cd4aa3221a0c5512.png

🩸 New Spell – Bloodspire
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

“Conjure a spear of blood that homes in on your foes, piercing through them and siphoning life back to you.”
Bloodspire lets you hurl a blood-forged spear that homes in on enemies, pierces through them, and heals you for each enemy hit. It also comes with its own 4 new blessings to expand its damage and healing potential.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/76a760b3fe5ff293ac9abd188c3eb927ea54f0ec.jpg



✨ 4 New Blessings
 Flameborne – Entering an inferno zone grants +10% damage for 5s (stacks).
 Ice Skin – Entering a frostbind zone grants +8% damage reduction for 5s (stacks).
 Corrupted Feast – Entering a blighted zone restores 2 health.
 Voltstride – Entering a shocked zone grants +10% movement speed for 5s (stacks).

🔮 What’s Next?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
We’re not slowing down, there’s much more content on the way! Upcoming updates will bring a new arena, a 4th difficulty tier, new weapons, spells, blessings, and improvements to existing arenas.

We’ll share more details in a separate announcement soon, but here’s a heads-up: HELLBREAK will be part of the Boomstock 2025 Steam Event in September, where we’ll also launch a major update.

🔥 As always, thank you for fighting, surviving, and giving us your feedback. It helps shape HELLBREAK into the best experience possible. Keep them coming through our Discord and Steam Discussions!

notes.title: Update – Steam Cloud Save, UI Improvements & More - July 31
notes.notes:
It’s been a little while since our last patch, but we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes. Today’s update brings a much-requested feature and sets the stage for what’s coming next!

☁️ Steam Cloud Save is Now Enabled!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

You can now sync your save data across devices using Steam Cloud Save.
We’ve tested this feature thoroughly, and it should work without issues. That said, we highly recommend backing up your local save file before syncing just in case. You can find your save files in this location:
AppData/Local/HELLBREAK/Saved/SaveGames/HELLBREAKSave
If you’ve uninstalled the game before this patch and lost your data, reach out to us on Discord and we’ll help you recover your save files.

🖥️ UI & Font Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Improved legibility across menus by increasing font and UI sizes
 Fixed incorrectly sized input icons for both keyboard and controller users


🐛 Bug Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Fixed a rare crash that could happen after killing a boss for the first time
 Fixed multiple text wrapping issues that caused overflow or unnecessary line breaks
 Fixed an issue that prevented leaderboards from functioning on Steam Deck
 Fixed an issue where connecting an external controller on Deck disabled the internal one until restart
 Fixed an issue where Hellshard tooltips appeared empty when using a controller


🕹️ Steam Deck Verification
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Due to the issues mentioned above, Steam had temporarily marked the game as unsupported on Steam Deck. With these fixes now in place, this status should be updated soon.

🔮 What’s Next
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We know it’s been a bit quiet this month, but big things are on the way!
We’re working on:

 A new arena
 New spells and weapons
 A 4th difficulty tierThe next patch is coming soon and will introduce:
A playable tutorial, especially for new players, to help ease into the chaos of HELLBREAK

Here’s a teaser from one of the new weapons we’ve been working on:
💀 Hint: it’s not a melee weapon…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/e7e78bd5486b21e73290edcc2fcf29b3cbe2b265.png

notes.title: Small Improvements & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
While we’re working on new content, today’s patch brings a set of smaller improvements, performance tweaks, and balance updates based on your feedback.

⚙️ Improvements
Further optimization of visual effects, helping improve performance on more systems.

Gamepad users: You can now adjust slider settings using the sticks, not just the D-pad.

⚖️ Balance Changes
 Shredder Upgrade – Damage increase per enemy sliced: 35% → 20%
 Shredder Upgrade – Ricochet damage bonus: 50% → 25%
 Virulent Decay (Blessing) – Blight spread damage: 75 → 100
 Doombringer’s Retribution – Headshot explosion damage: 200 → 300

🐛 Fixes
 Fixed multiple issues that caused the total ammo count of weapons to be incorrectly reduced in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where the movement speed upgrade of Omen would not always activate correctly

More updates are on the way as we continue improving HELLBREAK. Thanks for all your support, bug reports, and feedback. Keep them coming through Steam Discussions or Discord! 💀

notes.title: Performance & Optimization Patch – July 2
notes.notes:
Today’s patch brings some important improvements aimed at making HELLBREAK run smoother across a wider range of systems. This is one of several upcoming updates focused on performance and polish.

⚙️ Performance Improvements

Optimized lighting, visual effects, and overall map performance in both Necropit and Courtyard.Reduced stutters caused by curse effects, especially when multiple enemies are affected at once.Optimized the visual effects of each curse.Reduced stuttering caused by certain enemy attacks.Motion Blur and Bloom effects have been disabled to improve clarity and performance.

These changes should result in a 10–30% performance improvement  depending on hardware and settings. You may also notice fewer sudden frame drops and more consistent framerate across different graphics settings, especially between Medium and High.

This is not the end of our optimization work, more adjustments and improvements are already planned.

🔊 Other Changes
Adjusted the volume of several sound effects for better in-game clarity.

🐛 Fixes
Fixed a rare issue where banishing all upgrades of a weapon could cause the game to freeze during blessing selection.

🔄 Moving Forward
We’ll continue working on both performance improvements and general polish while also preparing new features like weapons, spells, and progression systems. Next patch will focus on balance changes and some more optimization work.

Thank you for all the feedback and bug reports, keep them coming via Steam Discussions or Discord!

notes.title: Hotfix – June 27
notes.notes:
Quick patch to address two important issues:


 Fixed a bug where banishing all 3 blessings would freeze blessing selection.
➤ You can now only banish up to 2 blessings before re-rolling.
 Fixed a rare issue where certain UI buttons (like Primary Weapon or Demon Lord profiles) would stop responding.


Thanks for the quick reports, keep them coming through Steam Discussions or Discord! 🔧🔥

notes.title: Quality of Life & Feature Update – June 25
notes.notes:
Big update today! We’ve heard your feedback and are excited to bring in some highly requested features and improvements that should make HELLBREAK smoother and more enjoyable, especially when it comes to consistency, clarity, and control.

⚠️ Reminder: Our 20% launch discount ends tomorrow!

🔥 New Features{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png


Choose Your Starting Weapon
You can now start a trial with any unlocked weapon!
We heard your frustration about not getting the weapon you want—this change gives you control and removes that friction. Some weapons were previously balanced around their rarity, but with upcoming features like weapon achievements, progression tracking, and more in-trial upgrades, we believe every weapon deserves a chance to shine. 
Blessing Banishing
You can now banish a blessing during selection, preventing it from showing up again in the same trial. As we add more blessings, this feature will become increasingly valuable.
New Player Guidance
After finishing their first trial and earning a hellshard, new players will now see a small popup explaining the Armory tab and how Hellshards work.
Clearer Damage Feedback
Based on your feedback, we’ve added pain grunt sounds when taking damage to improve clarity during chaotic moments.
Armory Perk Info
You can now view all perk descriptions for unlocked weapons in the Armory, even if a perk itself isn’t unlocked yet.
Improved Controller Navigation
Armory navigation is now smoother for controller users. The weapon info now updates automatically as you scroll through the list.
Optional Auto-Fire for Controllers
We noticed that repeatedly firing non-auto weapons (like the Banshee) could be tiring on a controller.
You can now enable a setting that lets non-auto weapons fire as if they were automatic (with a slightly reduced fire rate). This setting is fully optional and can be toggled in the settings (gameplay) menu.


⚙️ Balance Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Harbinger pellet damage reduced: 150 → 120
Shredder base damage reduced: 400 → 330
Serathiel’s final mission Blaze requirement: 20 → 10
Gholgoroth’s final mission Hex requirement: 15 → 10
Gholgoroth’s first mission Score requirement: 150k → 100k
Slightly reduced the Ripper spawns for the first difficulty of Necropit.


🐛 Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png


Fixed a rare bug where trials wouldn’t end even after all enemies were dead. Also added a failsafe: if no boss remains after 20:30, the trial will force-end.
Fixed an issue where progress for Var’zul’s 4th mission wasn’t saved between trials.
Fixed several UI navigation issues for controller users.


What’s Next?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

The next patch will focus on performance & optimization. Stay tuned.

As always, let us know what you think and keep sending us feedback and bug reports via Steam Discussions or Discord.

Thanks for playing, and see you in the arena 🔥

notes.title: Patch Notes (June 16)
notes.notes:
Thanks again for all your continued feedback and reports. We’re back with another update focused on improving progression clarity, wave stability, and overall experience flow.

Improvements & Fixes:


 Fixed a rare but important issue that caused some waves and bosses to not spawn properly.
 The “!” indicator will now stay visible if you have a completed mission reward waiting to be claimed.
 Rerolling a weapon or spell now guarantees a different one will appear—no more rerolling into the same item.
 The Courtyard arena will now unlock if you complete a trial in Necropit even if you don't finish the required missions.
 After picking up your first weapon, the game will only offer a new weapon 3 times until you level up more. This keeps the flow cleaner and avoids interruptions early on for people who want to use the Banshee.


We're hard at work polishing the game and making it smoother to play and progress through. If you encounter anything odd or have feedback, reach us via Steam Discussions or Discord.

See you in the arena 🔥

notes.title: Quality of Life & Balance Update – June 14
notes.notes:
Another patch is live! Today’s update brings some key quality of life improvements and balance changes based directly on your feedback and what we’ve been observing post-launch.

Quality of Life Improvements:

You can now push enemies (except bosses) by walking into them. No more getting body-blocked in tight spaces.

Any non-AoE damage you take from behind (off-screen) now deals 50% less damage. This should make surprise projectiles and backstabs a bit less punishing. We’ll keep an eye on this and adjust the value if necessary.

 You now gain +1 reroll every 5 level-ups to help with build variety and flexibility.


Bug Fixes:
Fixed a rare crash issue related to the first perk of the Bloodfang.

Fixed an issue where the charged melee animation could get stuck.

Fixed a bug where the first level of the headshot damage increase perk was dealing more damage than the amount shown.

Balance Changes:

Increased the base damage of the Banshee (starting pistol) by 5. This ensures that Tormented enemies now die in 2 headshots instead of 3, even without upgrades.

Slightly reduced EXP requirements for the first few level-ups to smooth out early pacing.

Reduced the homing speed of Oculon’s mines.


Mission Changes:

Serathiel – Mission 2: Apply Inferno to 20 enemies → now 15

Gholgoroth – Mission 2: Apply Blight to 25 enemies → now 15

Varkoth – Mission 2: Use any spell 5 times → now 2


Let us know how it feels! As always, we’re active on Discord and checking the Steam Discussions regularly.

Thanks again for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Thank You + Patch Notes (June 13)
notes.notes:
HELLBREAKERS!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png


First off, thank you to everyone who’s bought HELLBREAK and joined us in the arena! Your support means the world to our small team. We’ve been closely following all your feedback and bug reports since launch, and this update addresses several key issues and makes a few balance tweaks based on what we’ve seen and heard.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a rare crash affecting some players. We believe this should be fully resolved now, but we’re ready to jump on it immediately if it happens again. Please let us know on the Steam forums or in our Discord if it does. Upgrading a weapon will now guarantee it appears during your next trial, similar to unlocking. The sensitivity slider in the settings menu is now more flexible for better control. Fixed a bug preventing aim assist from being fully disabled for gamepad users. Made the aim assist strength slider more adjustable as well.
Balance Changes:
 Reduced the number of imps that spawn in Necropit on the default difficulty.  Slightly lowered the speed of imp projectiles.
We’ll keep iterating and improving based on your feedback, please keep it coming! You can post on the Steam Discussions or hop into our Discord server and chat with us directly.

More updates soon, and again, thank you for playing HELLBREAK!

notes.title: HELLBREAK Demo Ending Soon, Big Changes Ahead!
notes.notes:
Greetings Warriors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

From the very start of the demo’s release, through Steam Next Fest, and beyond, your feedback has been invaluable in shaping HELLBREAK. We’ve seen thousands of players jump into the arena, and every bit of input has helped us refine our vision for the game. Thank you for playing, sharing your thoughts, and supporting us on this journey!

With that in mind, we want to let you know that the demo will be taken down this Friday as we shift our focus to some major improvements. We’re making big changes to core systems, including blessings, progression, and more. This rework will take time, but we are committed to delivering the best possible experience when HELLBREAK returns.

Here’s a sneak peek at some of the big changes coming:


 Acquire any weapon and spell during a trial through blessings
 Upgrade weapons with unique modifiers and stat bonuses mid-trial
 Equip multiple spells at the same time for more diverse combat options
 Revamped main progression to ensure each trial feels rewarding
 Layered difficulty system—lowered default difficulty with new challenge tiers that offer unique rewards and progression
 More interactive blessings to enhance the feeling of power as trials progress
 Complete Melee Revamp—expect overhauled mechanics, new melee weapons, and deeper combat interactions
 More enemies and bosses to make each trial more intense and dynamic
 New arenas to bring fresh battlefields and challenges
 TONS MORE GUNS AND SPELLS to expand your arsenal


To ensure we deliver all these changes and more at the early access launch, we have postponed the EA release date to Q2 2025. Our aim is to release before summer, giving us the time needed to make HELLBREAK the best it can be.

Stay tuned for updates as we share more details on what’s changing and what’s coming next. If you want to stay involved, join our Discord, we’d love to keep hearing your thoughts as we continue development.

Thank you again for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to show you what’s next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

See you in hell,
The HELLBREAK Team

notes.title: Big Steam Next Fest Patch: New Arena, Codex, Frostbind Rework, Blessing Changes
notes.notes:
Hello, HELLBREAK fans!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We’ve been hard at work making some exciting changes, fixes, and additions to the game. With Steam Next Fest around the corner, we’re rolling out a huge patch to improve and expand HELLBREAK Demo. Check out the details below, and get ready to dive back into the arena!

New Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

New Arena: Courtyard
We’re introducing a brand-new arena, the Courtyard! This arena is vastly different from Necropit in terms of aesthetics and has a much more complex layout. We were a bit concerned about including it in the demo as it’s still being polished, especially in terms of optimization, but we wanted to showcase the direction we’re heading in with the support we’ve received. In the full game, each arena will have its own set of enemy waves and bosses. For demo purposes, the Courtyard will feature the same enemy waves as Necropit, so you’ll be facing off against Gorath in this completely new environment. And don’t forget, each arena comes with its own leaderboards, so make sure to get those high scores before anyone else!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/75fc9758b87d0b32e226694f29f697f31e6ffc21.png

Codex Page
We’ve added a brand new Codex page! Here, you can see lore and combat information about all the enemies you've killed, inspect their 3D models, and complete kill missions to gain a permanent damage boost against them. Each enemy has a unique kill mission, and upon completing it, you’ll gain a small damage boost for them. Bosses have even more unique rewards than a simple damage boost. As you’ll see, the enemy list is much longer than what you saw in the demo, and this isn’t even the full roster for Early Access. There are so many more enemies and bosses coming your way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/8af9b2d8bf2248a8fe0c3dc4c2d38cb368d4c10b.png

Frostbind Curse Rework
We noticed that the Frostbind curse wasn’t as interactive or impactful as the other curses. So, we’ve reworked it to be more engaging and fun. Now, Frostbound enemies cannot move or deal damage. And if their health drops below 20%, they shatter and die immediately. Bosses shatter at 10% health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/cf59f7b5395b385d9bc0b4e67815913956ec4052.png

New Blessings

 Shrapnel Storm: Your grenade splits into 3 smaller grenades, each with 65% of the original damage and radius.
 Scavenger Adrenaline: Gain 10% damage and 5% movement speed for 5 seconds after picking up ammo.
 Static Surge: Enemies you dash through are shocked for 5 seconds.
 Blazing Path: Dashing through enemies applies inferno for 5 seconds.
 Bottomless Reserves: Total ammo capacity increased by 10%.
 Extended Chambers: Gain 10% extra magazine size.
 Battle Instinct: Gain 20% more experience.

New Blessings Tied to Blaze Spell 🔥:

 Ashen Blast: Upon deactivating Blaze, release a wave of inferno around you.
 Flame-Fueled Rage: While Blaze is active, your weapons deal 100% more damage.
 Infernal Sustenance: Gain 1 health for every 4 enemies affected by inferno.
 Unquenchable Flames: Blaze duration is increased by 100%.


Language Support
We now support Brazilian Portuguese!

Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Player Starting Gear Update 
After careful consideration, we’ve decided to start the player with the Viper (SMG) and Aegis (Shield Spell) unlocked and equipped. This means that the first missions for Varkoth and Serathiel will be considered as completed if you haven’t completed them already. Our thought process behind this change was that most players do not spend too much time playing demos, and since Next Fest is going to feature a lot of them, we want to ensure that players will have a better experience with the game even if they only spend a short amount of time. If you’ve already progressed beyond this point, this change will not affect you.

Balance Changes
Banshee (Pistol): The Banshee is now 40% more accurate, making it a more reliable weapon in your arsenal.
Hex Cooldown: Increased to 25 seconds (was 20).
Blaze Cooldown: Decreased to 35 seconds (was 40).

Blessing Changes:

 Mark of Precision: Increases weapon accuracy by 30% but reduces damage by 10% -> 7%.
 Soulseeker's Precision: Increases headshot damage by 30% -> 15%, but reduces body damage by 15% -> 7%.
 Infernal Endurance: Increases max health by 20%, but reduces health gained from all sources by 15% -> 10%.
 Abyssal Sacrifice: Your max health is reduced by 20%, but you regenerate 1 health per 20 -> 25 meters.
 Soulbound Vengeance: Gain a stack each time you kill an enemy, up to 15 -> 10 stacks. Each stack grants you 3% damage. You lose a stack every 2 -> 1 seconds.



Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Gameplay Fixes

 Improved AI pathfinding and targeting, fixing issues that caused enemies to get stuck (including bosses).
 Fixed an issue causing some pickups to spawn with weird angles.
 Fixed an issue preventing the player from picking up ammo if their equipped weapon was full, even when another weapon wasn’t.
 Fixed an issue with Hex Totem spawning in weird places, especially when triggered mid-air.
 Fixed an issue where enemies spawned underground in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where Gorath's charge ability didn't steer towards the player. Now improved for more direct targeting.
 Fixed an issue with Hex-related blessings resetting the curse type applied by the Hex, which negated the effects of the Elemental Hex blessing.

Visual Fixes

 Fixed an issue causing red damage indicator areas to stretch when near vertical surfaces.
 Fixed an issue that caused some enemy-related VFX to stay active in the level after the related enemy died (e.g., the Scorched's flame VFX).
 Fixed an issue causing frostbound enemies to rotate weirdly in some cases.
 Fixed an issue that was preventing the main menu background movie from playing correctly on some devices.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

As always, thank you so much for your support! We’re still working hard to bring you even more content, fixes, and improvements as we move toward Early Access. Keep the feedback and bug reports coming, and be sure to jump into the game to explore all these new features!

See you in the arena gladiators!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

notes.title: HELLBREAK Joins Steam Next Fest – Big Demo Update Coming!
notes.notes:
We've been quiet for a bit, but we’re back with exciting news!

notes.title: Demo Update #6
notes.notes:
Greetings, champions of hell! 🩸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

A new update has arrived with more fixes and improvements to enhance your experience. While it’s been a while since the last patch, we’ve been hard at work on the full game, which is why updates to the demo have slowed down a bit. Rest assured, as we approach the Early Access launch, the demo will continue to receive updates and some exciting new features to prepare you for what’s coming.

Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Key displays now update correctly after assigning a custom value and then resetting to default.
 Gorath will no longer charge toward the player if there is an elevation difference between him and the player.
 Resolved and improved multiple issues with flying enemy AI.
 Fixed an issue causing ranged enemies to stay idle for 1 second in certain scenarios.
 Resolved a bug where the game wouldn't end correctly if the last enemy timed out instead of being killed.
 Fixed and improved multiple issues related to sliding near walls.
 Resolved a rare issue causing enemy attack cooldowns to pause intermittently.
 Fixed an issue where the weapon buff overlay was not appearing for the Rip&Tear blessing (damage after melee hit).


New & Improved
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Japanese Localization: The game is now available in Japanese!
 The Grimoire now opens automatically during your first blessing selection, making it easier to understand blessings. After the first time, it can still be accessed manually during blessing selection.
 Blessings are now not clickable for the first 0.5 seconds after opening the blessing selection screen, preventing accidental selections.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We’re so excited about what’s ahead for HELLBREAK and can’t wait to share more with you. Thank you for your continued support, it means everything to us!

🔥 See you in the arena! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

notes.title: Demo Update #5
notes.notes:
Greetings, warriors of the damned! 🩸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Another update is here, bringing crucial fixes and balance changes to enhance your trials in hell. Dive into the details below!

Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Resolved an issue where cooldown-affecting blessings (e.g., dash cooldown reduction on kill) would reset the cooldown if the timer went below 0.
 Fixed an issue where area-affecting blessings did not update correctly, causing some enemies to be affected even when out of range.
 Addressed a bug that broke Gorath’s AI when stunned during his charge attack.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the Grimoire and Active Blessings menu from opening after completing the first trial in a play session.
 Resolved an issue causing the main menu background to stretch on wide screens.
 Fixed bugs that caused some health regeneration blessings to not count towards health regeneration missions.
 Fixed an issue where certain blessings, especially those related to health regeneration, disrupted on-screen effects like taking damage or Aegis visuals.
 Resolved an issue where mouse inputs were ignored for skipping loading screens.


Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
Soul Erosion Blessing Update

 The side effect of this blessing, which reduced the healing of health pickups by 80%, has been adjusted to now reduce healing by only 30%.
 The second blessing reward of Gholgoroth (Soul Erosion) has had its color adjusted for easier differentiation from the first reward.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’re dedicated to ensuring HELLBREAK delivers the best possible experience. Keep sending your thoughts, and we’ll keep the updates coming.

🔥 See you in the arena! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.notes:
Greetings, gladiators! 🩸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We’ve rolled out another update to improve your gameplay experience, fix some pesky bugs, and make tweaks to keep the action as intense as ever. But first, a huge thank you to everyone who supported us during the Bullet Heaven Fest, despite only having a demo, HELLBREAK was one of the most popular games in the event! Your enthusiasm drives us to make the game even better. Check out the full details of this update below:

Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Fixed an issue where controller inputs for UI buttons would continue working when the related UI was not visible, causing multiple issues such as resetting key bind changes.
 Resolved and improved various issues related to AI navigation.
 Fixed an issue that prevented mouse inputs from being bound to movement actions.
 Fixed an issue where the mouse icon could interact with UI while invisible, causing some buttons to appear highlighted.
 Fixed an issue allowing the same blessing to be equipped twice in some cases.
 Addressed multiple focus and highlight issues on the equipment screen.
 Improved an issue causing projectile effects to sometimes briefly appear excessively long in length.


Steam Deck Focused Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
[olist]
 Default resolution is now set to 1280x720p. New users will have this setting applied automatically, while existing users are recommended to use the auto-detect option in the video settings.
 Fixed an issue causing controller icons to display as PlayStation icons instead of Xbox.
[/olist]

Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 No More Pickup Timers: Health and ammo pickups will now remain active indefinitely, removing the previous 30-second timer.
 Increased Ammo for Demo Weapons: The total ammo count for the Banshee, Viper, and Bloodfang has been increased by one clip each, adding 9, 25, and 6 extra ammo respectively.
 Ranged Enemy Tweaks: Ranged enemies now have a rotation limit, giving players a better chance to dodge projectiles at close range, especially when dashing.
 Warden (Red Crystal-Throwing Enemies) Range Reduction: The maximum range of the Warden enemy has been reduced from 50m to 30m for a fairer challenge.
 Consistent Blessing Effects: Weapon-related blessings, such as applying a curse, now consistently trigger before damage is applied. Previously, effects like the Inferno explosion might not trigger if the enemy died too quickly.
 Improved Blessing Differentiation: The second blessing reward (Abyssal Ward) of Varkoth has had its color adjusted to make it easier to distinguish from the first reward.
 Clickable Key Displays: The key displays for Esc, Options, and the Active Blessings menu are now clickable.
 UI Visibility Improvements: The font size for Combat Tips and the Soul count has been increased for better readability.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Thank you once again for your incredible support and for helping HELLBREAK shine in the Bullet Heaven Fest! Keep sending your feedback, and we’ll continue pushing updates to make the game even better.
🔥 See you in the arena! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, warriors!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

This latest patch introduces several quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and some new features to enhance your experience in the arena of hell. Read on for the full details!

Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png


 Resolved an issue causing Gorath to bend unnaturally when hit (no more awkward contortions).
 Fixed a problem where selected item highlight in the settings menu occasionally disappeared, both for controllers and mouse users.


Changes & New Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Blessings Filtered by Availability: Blessings will now only appear if they’re relevant to your current loadout. For example, weapon-switching blessings won’t appear if you only have one weapon, and curse-related blessings won’t show up unless you can apply that curse.
 Wall Sliding: You will now slide along walls when moving directly toward them, reducing the chances of getting stuck, especially when walking backwards.
 Automatic Weapon Switching: If you try to fire but your weapon is out of ammo, the game will now automatically switch to a loaded weapon (if available).
 Localization Update: French localization is now available! 🇫🇷
 Mission Adjustments: 
-The score requirement for Gholgoroth’s first mission has been reduced from 175,000 to 75,000, making it more accessible to newcomers.
-The kill requirement for Varkoth’s first mission has been reduced from 30 to 20.
 Mouse Smoothing: A new Mouse Smoothing option has been added to the settings menu. It’s enabled by default but can be turned off if you prefer a raw input feel.
Improved Curse Explanation Visibility: The Grimoire button (which explains what curses do that everyone ignored...) is now more visible in the blessing selection screen.
Mission and Blessing Menus: The Missions/Selected Blessings menu is now also accessible during the blessing selection screen. A key reminder has been added to help players know how to open it.


We’re continuously improving HELLBREAK based on your feedback, so keep it coming! Let us know how these changes impact your gameplay and what you'd like to see next. Join our Discord below!

🔥 See you in the pit! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re thrilled with the amazing support we’ve received over the weekend. Your reviews and comments mean the world to us. Thank you for being a part of this journey! We’ve been hard at work addressing your feedback and are excited to share the first update to the demo.

Here’s what’s new:

Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Resolved an issue where spells would remain locked after unlocking if the player interacted with the equipment menu beforehand.
 Fixed various typos and localization errors.
 Fixed some map related issues.


Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Increased the chances of ammo drops.
 Ammo refills now spawn when either weapon runs low on ammo, instead of waiting for both primary and secondary.
 Grenade damage increased from 500 to 600, and the full damage radius is now 4m (up from 3m).
 Melee range has been significantly increased.
 Melee animation speed has been increased.
 Increased the size of the Melee and Mission menu key indicators to make them more noticable at the start of the game.
 Adjusted Serathiel’s first mission requirements: survival time reduced from 3 minutes and 30 seconds to 2 minutes and 30 seconds. The cost to unlock the Viper weapon as a reward has been reduced to 500 (down from 1000).


New Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

 Melee now has a pushback effect! Don't let the enemies stand in your way!
 Russian and Chinese localizations are now available! French and Brazilian Portuguese are coming soon.
 Added an option in the Inputs menu to invert camera pitch.


Thank You!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Your feedback helps us make HELLBREAK better. We’re aware of some lingering bugs and are already preparing another update to address them. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please join our Discord channel and let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

Thank you for playing and supporting HELLBREAK. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep surviving the arena!

— The HELLBREAK Team

notes.title: Community Update #5 : Demo Page & Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
🔥 HELLBREAK Demo Page is Now Live + Demo Release Date Announcement! 🔥
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We're thrilled to announce that the HELLBREAK demo will be launching on November 29th! You can now visit our demo page on Steam to learn more and prepare to descend into the arena of hell.



What's in the Demo?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

💀 Three Demon Lords
Prove your worth and earn favor from three powerful demon lords, each offering unique rewards:

 3 Demonic Weapons forged in the fires of hell.
 3 Devastating Spells to unleash chaos upon your enemies.

🏟️ One Blood-soaked Arena
Survive relentless waves of enemies for up to 10 minutes, culminating in an epic first boss fight.

✨ Over 80 Blessings
Shape your playstyle by choosing from a massive pool of blessings that provide exciting modifiers and strategic options.


🏆 Compete on the Leaderboards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Leaderboards will be available during the demo! Show off your skills and fight for glory with global and friend leaderboards! Compete to see who can achieve the highest score and dominate the arena.

🎮 Controller Support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
HELLBREAK fully supports Xbox controllers right now, with Steam Input integration in progress to expand compatibility to other controllers.

🌍 Localization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
The demo is currently available in English, Turkish, and Simplified Chinese. More languages will be added over time, so don’t worry if yours isn’t supported yet!

🛠️ Feedback is Key
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png
As this is our first public demo, we’d love your help identifying any bugs, glitches, or performance issues. Your feedback will help us improve the game! You can share your thoughts on:


 The Steam forums
 Or join our Discord Channel:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/78acaa20fda21f4cf2cf1e1796a7b6f3fbe134a8.png

Prepare to fight for your soul and earn your place in the depths of hell. Mark your calendars for November 29th, and make sure to try the demo!

notes.title: Community Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings Warriors!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Welcome back to another deep dive into the mechanics of HELLBREAK! As you prepare to take on the demonic arena, we want to give you an edge by explaining one of the most powerful tools in your arsenal: Curses. These potent effects can turn the tide of battle, and when combined with the right blessings, they become even more deadly.


Harness the Power of Curses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Curses are powerful debuffs you can apply to enemies, giving you control over the battlefield. From spreading chaos among crowds to freezing your enemies in place, curses are crucial to your survival in the arena. Let's take a quick look at each of them.


🔥 Inferno 🔥
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Fiery Demise

Infernal enemies explode upon death, dealing a percentage of their max HP as damage to others nearby. The more enemies you take down in clusters, the bigger the explosions and the bigger the carnage.


❄️ Frostbind ❄️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Total Paralysis

Frostbound enemies are completely frozen, unable to move or deal damage. Use this to lock down high-priority threats or groups, giving yourself breathing room to tackle other challenges.

⚡ Shock ⚡
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Chain Lightning Carnage

Striking a Shocked enemy causes chain lightning, dealing a percentage of the initial damage to nearby foes. Shock is perfect for decimating tightly packed enemies with minimal effort.

🧪 Blight 🧪
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Contagious Destruction

Blighted enemies take increased damage and spread Blight to nearby foes when they die. This makes it easy to weaken large groups and create chain reactions that turn the arena into a deadly trap.

Enhance Your Curses with Blessings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Curses on their own are powerful, but when paired with the right blessings, they become unstoppable. Some Blessings modify how curses work or provide new ways to apply them, giving you greater control over the battlefield.

Here is an example of blessings that take your curses to the next level:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/1b00ef10f06ace7173fdfacd447478c4a424bb40.png

Join our discord channel below to stay updated,
See you in the arena!

notes.title: Community Update #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

In this update, we're excited to dive into the progression system of HELLBREAK and explain how you can earn favor from the powerful demonic lords of the underworld. These lords won’t just hand out rewards—you’ll have to fight for their attention and complete their missions to earn their favor.


How It Works
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

As you continue fighting in HELLBREAK, more demonic lords will start to take notice of your strength. Each lord has their own expectations, and to earn their favor, you’ll need to fight in the way that pleases them. Completing their missions will allow you to sacrifice souls you have earned during your battles to them. In return you will receive valuable rewards that unlock new possibilities in your battles. And it will also unlock the next tier of recognition.

Below, you can check out a sneak peek of the progression UI screen that shows your standing with each demon lord. Please note that everything is still a work in progress and subject to change as development continues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/89fa2113a04bc17b141877949a26046de6836dd0.png

Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Earning favor from the demonic lords offers four main types of rewards:


 New Weapons: Unlock powerful demonic weapons
 New Spells: Cast new spells to dominate the battlefield
 New Blessings: Gain modifiers that enhance your combat abilities.
 Permanent Upgrades: Earn lasting boosts to your character, making you even stronger for future trials.

Below, you can also see a glimpse of the upgrades screen, where you’ll manage the permanent upgrades you’ve unlocked. Again, please note that everything is still a work in progress and may be updated as development continues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/e557543d73fb5faf4ea362ec496e339255994087.png

Introducing Varkoth, the Tormented Enforcer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We’re thrilled to introduce Varkoth as one of the first demon lords you’ll encounter in HELLBREAK.

Varkoth stands as a relentless embodiment of discipline and punishment. His skeletal visage and bound limbs are a testament to his harsh and unyielding nature. With a cruel and calculating demeanor, he takes pleasure in enforcing his brutal will upon others. His presence is a chilling reminder of the extreme consequences for defiance, reveling in the power of control and the agony it imposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/b1fc252c7593fa24103eb65e1850d5d81ce3bc3a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue revealing more about the weapons, spells, and demon lords of HELLBREAK!

See you in the arena!

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, we want to thank all of you for the incredible support since we launched the Steam page for HELLBREAK. We’ve been working tirelessly to bring this game to life, and we’re thrilled to see the excitement building within our community. Your comments, feedback, and questions have been invaluable, and we’re keeping a close eye on everything you share.

Starting today, we’ll be sharing regular updates about the game and our development progress to keep you in the loop with what we’re working on and what’s coming up. Let’s dive into what we’ve been up to and our plans for the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

What We've Been Up To

Since the Steam page launch, we’ve been hard at work polishing up the game and incorporating your feedback into our development process. From refining the weapons and spells to perfecting the chaos of the arena, our goal is to deliver an intense, fast-paced experience that feels rewarding. We've also been busy behind the scenes setting up what we believe will be the best way for you to experience HELLBREAK before its release.

We’re also preparing to share more details about the enemies you’ll face, the spells you can wield, and the demonic weapons you’ll unleash in HELLBREAK. And of course, we’ll be diving deeper into the progression system featuring the demon lords and how you can earn their favor. We’re excited to give you a closer look at all these elements soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/6585f391f70034ce0c47b8ca83aab5b8aa39b196.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Playtest Coming Soon

We’re excited to announce that we’re preparing a closed playtest on Steam! This will be an opportunity for a select group of players to get their hands on the game and provide us with critical feedback as we move forward. We’ll be sharing more details on when this will be available, so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/cdb1c31e00c63f70ac5e7740204a58005bad4b6d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Demo Planned

For those who might not make it into the playtest, don’t worry! We’re also planning to release a free open demo before the end of November. This will give everyone a chance to experience a taste of the hellish chaos that HELLBREAK has to offer. The demo will include a variety of weapons, spells, and a look at the kinds of challenges you’ll face in the full game. We plan on updating the demo as we polish up more and more content until the early access launch. We can’t wait to hear what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/823117bd76b846320f77a4039a42f3a6f0afe993.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

Early Access Launch Target: Q1 2025

Looking ahead, our goal is to launch the game in Early Access in Q1 2025. We’re taking the time to ensure HELLBREAK is the best it can be, with a brutal and satisfying roguelite experience that keeps you coming back for more. Your feedback will be crucial as we fine-tune the game, so keep sharing your thoughts and ideas with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/18e5784fcab9047b97fdf5d8e421d9ac815261d3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139459/9f1969b0d9baeca4714544cadd2cb9184aa2ecea.png

We’re incredibly grateful to have such a passionate community this early, and we’re looking forward to sharing more updates about our progress and plans. Keep an eye on our Steam page, follow us on our social media channels, and join our Discord server to stay connected.

See you in hell,
The HELLBREAK Team
